highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: Saba University School of Medicine is a prestigious medical school located in the Caribbean, renowned for offering high-quality medical education. Founded in 1992, Saba University has become one of the leading institutions for aspiring medical students worldwide. Plus, Saba is accredited by the Netherlands Ministry of Education and recognised by medical boards in the USA and Canada.

highlights.title: Student life
highlights.value: You’ll be part of a global student community at Saba University, with various student-run clubs. You can meet students from over 30 countries on campus. Moreover, Saba University provides robust student support, including academic counselling, career services, and mentorship programmes.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value: Saba University School of Medicine doesn't directly provide housing, but helps you find suitable accommodation nearby.

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
On campus, you’ll find the WFM Johnson Medical Library with extensive medical resources, textbooks, journals, and online databases.

Sports
The university has several athletic facilities and fitness centres to keep you active.

Laboratory
You’ll find many modern, well-equipped laboratories for subjects like anatomy, biochemistry, and microbiology. You’ll also gain hands-on experience in the Clinical Skills Training Centre.

Cafeteria
You can enjoy a variety of meal options at the campus cafeteria and dining areas.
